start.speaker: Gardener
start.text: Evening, Igor. Back from the outskirts again?

choices.text: You know they used to grow food in fields? Outside, in the open.

fields.speaker: Gardener
fields.text: Outside? In the dirt, with nothing filtering the water?

choices.text: Miles of it. Then trucks drove it into the cities, every single day.

trucks.speaker: Gardener
trucks.text: That's a lot of driving for a tomato.

choices.text: And nobody lived in an arcology. Every family had its own little house, spread out for miles.

houses.speaker: Gardener
houses.text: A whole building for one family? Who looked after their gardens? Here the [url=arcology]arcology[/url] does it all. You read too many old things, [url=igor kozlov]Igor[/url].

choices.text: Some people grow tomatoes. I dig up old things.
